image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two whole green cucumbers and one sliced cucumber end resting on a speckled white surface. The cucumbers have a bumpy, textured green skin with visible water droplets. The sliced section reveals the internal pale flesh and seed structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Some water droplets appear slightly 'painted on' or lack perfect refractive clarity, blending softly into the skin texture rather than sitting sharply on top. This is a minor AI-generation tell but does not break structural integrity.

The internal structure of the sliced cucumber end is slightly 'mushy' or ill-defined. The boundaries between the seed locules and the flesh are softer than a real knife cut would produce, showing slight melting/fusion of internal tissues.
